lookup_hash.description: Check whether a file is known by looking up its MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash in CIRCL hashlookup, a free database of billions of files from NIST's NSRL, Linux distributions, Windows builds and app stores. A known file comes back with its name, size, every hash, the product or package it ships with, a trust score and some of the packages it is in; an unknown one comes back with Found set to false instead of failing the step. Being known doesn't make a file safe by itself: check Known malicious and the trust score too.

description: Check whether a file is known with CIRCL hashlookup, the free database of billions of files from NIST's NSRL, Linux distributions, Windows builds and app stores run by Luxembourg's CERT: look up an MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 to get the file's name, size, product or package, trust score and malware flag, check up to 1,000 hashes at once, list the packages a file ships in and the files inside a package, and see the most looked-up hashes. No account needed.
